title: Intraoperative Use of a Topical Anesthetic Gel Versus Balanced Salt Solution During Cataract Surgery: Effects on Corneal Structure and Ocular Surface

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: ali:license_ref https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license, MDPI)

indication: Age-related cataract, standardized temporal phacoemulsification with foldable posterior chamber IOL by one surgeon; exclusions: dry eye disease, previous ocular surgery, contact lens wear, diabetes, glaucoma, corneal dystrophies

groups.description: Ophtesic 20 mg/g topical anesthetic gel (Horus Pharma), 1 g applied to the corneal surface after disinfection and speculum insertion; no intraoperative BSS irrigation except a 2 mL rinse at the end of surgery; same lidocaine drops, surgeon and postoperative regimen (dexamethasone/netilmicin, bromfenac) as the BSS group; 15 eyes of 15 patients
Balanced salt solution applied repeatedly to the cornea during surgery (maximum 15 mL); standard care; 9 eyes of 9 patients

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye, measured 3 days before surgery (Table 2 column 'Pre-Op'); AS-OCT MS-39, CSO (Methods 2.4)
series.notes: Table 2 row 'CCT (µm)' / 'GEL group'; mean ± SEM (not SD); postoperative days 1, 5 and 15 converted with days/30.4375; per-visit n not reported (15 eyes enrolled)

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye, measured 3 days before surgery (Table 2 column 'Pre-Op'); AS-OCT MS-39, CSO (Methods 2.4)
series.notes: Table 2 row 'CCT (µm)' / 'BSS group'; mean ± SEM (not SD); postoperative days 1, 5 and 15 converted with days/30.4375; per-visit n not reported (9 eyes enrolled)

exclusions.what: Table 2 epithelial thickness, BEC density, NI-BUT, Schirmer and OSDI rows

notes: Role: the topical anesthetic gel applied to the cornea is the study's investigational intraoperative agent (treated); repeated BSS irrigation is the standard comparator (control).
Allocation: 15 patients assigned to the gel group and 9 to the BSS observation group (Results); randomization is not described.
Dispersion in Table 2 is the standard error of the mean (caption and Methods 2.5).
